﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: jakarta.validation-api 2.0.2 -> 3.0.2

## Context

Project `wicket-crudifier` (by premium-minds) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`jakarta.validation:jakarta.validation-api` from `2.0.2` to `3.0.2` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/premium-minds/wicket-crudifier/pull/91

## Your Task

The source code is in `/wicket-crudifier`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and the specific errors.

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

	<groupId>com.premiumminds</groupId>
	<artifactId>wicket-crudifier</artifactId>
	<version>5.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
	<packaging>jar</packaging>

	<name>wicket-crudifier</name>
	<description>wicket-crudifier is a library to easily create CRUD's with wicket</description>
	<inceptionYear>2014</inceptionYear>

	<organization>
		<name>Premium Minds</name>
		<url>http://www.premium-minds.com</url>
	</organization>

	<licenses>
		<license>
			<name>GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE</name>
			<url>http://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl.html</url>
		</license>
	</licenses>

	<url>https://github.com/premium-minds/wicket-crudifier</url>

	<scm>
		<url>https://github.com/premium-minds/wicket-crudifier</url>
		<connection>scm:git:git@github.com:premium-minds/wicket-crudifier.git</connection>
		<developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:premium-minds/wicket-crudifier.git</developerConnection>
		<tag>HEAD</tag>
	</scm>

	<developers>
		<developer>
			<name>André Camilo</name>
			<organization>Premium Minds</organization>
		</developer>
		<developer>
			<name>Filipe Roque</name>
			<organization>Premium Minds</organization>
		</developer>
	</developers>

	<properties>
		<wicket.version>9.14.0</wicket.version>
		<project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
		<java.version>11</java.version>
	</properties>

	<dependencies>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.apache.wicket</groupId>
			<artifactId>wicket-core</artifactId>
			<version>${wicket.version}</version>
			<scope>provided</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.apache.wicket</groupId>
			<artifactId>wicket-extensions</artifactId>
			<version>${wicket.version}</version>
			<scope>provided</scope>
		</dependency>

		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.premiumminds</groupId>
			<artifactId>pm-wicket-utils</artifactId>
			<version>5.0</version>
		</dependency>

		<dependency>
			<groupId>com.premiumminds</groupId>
			<artifactId>pm-wicket-utils-testing</artifactId>
			<version>5.0</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>

		<dependency>
			<groupId>commons-beanutils</groupId>
			<artifactId>commons-beanutils</artifactId>
			<version>1.9.4</version>
		</dependency>

		<dependency>
			<groupId>jakarta.validation</groupId>
			<artifactId>jakarta.validation-api</artifactId>
			<version>3.0.2</version>
			<scope>provided</scope>
		</dependency>

		<!-- TEST DEPENDENCIES -->
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
			<artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
			<version>5.9.3</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>jakarta.servlet</groupId>
			<artifactId>jakarta.servlet-api</artifactId>
			<version>4.0.4</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.easymock</groupId>
			<artifactId>easymock</artifactId>
			<version>5.1.0</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.hibernate.validator</groupId>
			<artifactId>hibernate-validator</artifactId>
			<version>6.2.0.Final</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>org.glassfish</groupId>
			<artifactId>jakarta.el</artifactId>
			<version>3.0.4</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
	</dependencies>
	<build>
		<plugins>
			<plugin>
				<inherited>true</inherited>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.11.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<source>${java.version}</source>
					<target>${java.version}</target>
					<release>${java.version}</release>
					<optimize>true</optimize>
					<debug>true</debug>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.1.0</version>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.3.0</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-sources</id>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.5.0</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-javadocs</id>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>

			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.3.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<archive>
						<manifestEntries>
							<Automatic-Module-Name>com.premiumminds.wicket.crudifier</Automatic-Module-Name>
						</manifestEntries>
					</archive>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>

			<plugin>
				<groupId>com.mycila.maven-license-plugin</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-license-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>1.10.b1</version>
				<configuration>
					<header>licence-preamble.txt</header>
					<strictCheck>true</strictCheck>
					<failIfMissing>true</failIfMissing>
					<includes>
						<include>src/**</include>
						<include>**/test/**</include>
					</includes>
					<excludes>
						<exclude>target/**</exclude>
					</excludes>
					<mapping>
						<yml>SCRIPT_STYLE</yml>
					</mapping>
					<properties>
						<project-name>${project.name}</project-name>
						<year>2014</year>
						<owner>Premium Minds</owner>
					</properties>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>

			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-release-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.0.1</version>
				<configuration>
					<autoVersionSubmodules>true</autoVersionSubmodules>

		<developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:premium-minds/wicket-crudifier.git</developerConnection>
		<tag>HEAD</tag>
	</scm>

		<developer>

		</developer>

			<artifactId>pm-wicket-utils</artifactId>

		</dependency>
		<dependency>
			<groupId>jakarta.servlet</groupId>
			<artifactId>jakarta.servlet-api</artifactId>
			<version>4.0.4</version>
			<scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>

			<groupId>org.easymock</groupId>
			<artifactId>easymock</artifactId>
			<version>5.1.0</version>
			<scope>test</scope>

			<groupId>org.hibernate.validator</groupId>

			<groupId>org.glassfish</groupId>

					<optimize>true</optimize>

				<artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>

				<artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>

				<executions>
					<execution>

						<goals>
							<goal>jar</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>

			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.3.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<archive>
						<manifestEntries>
							<Automatic-Module-Name>com.premiumminds.wicket.crudifier</Automatic-Module-Name>
						</manifestEntries>
					</archive>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>

			<plugin>
				<groupId>com.mycila.maven-license-plugin</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-license-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>1.10.b1</version>
				<configuration>
					<header>licence-preamble.txt</header>
					<strictCheck>true</strictCheck>
					<failIfMissing>true</failIfMissing>

The fundamental issue is:
1. The code uses `HibernateValidatorProperty.validatorFactory` which is `javax.validation.ValidatorFactory`
2. The project now has `jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2` on the classpath
3. But `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` (the library providing `HibernateValidatorProperty`) was built against `javax.validation`

The cleanest fix that doesn't require changing external dependencies is to modify the code to create its own Jakarta-compatible `ValidatorFactory`. Let me update the code to:

1. Change `hibernate-validator` to use version 7.x (jakarta version) and move it to provided/compile scope
2. Modify the code to create its own ValidatorFactory instead of using the one from `HibernateValidatorProperty`

raw_arguments.description: Run Maven tests to verify full build

steps.message:
The test failures are due to:
1. Missing jakarta.el dependency (needed for hibernate-validator 7.x)
2. `pm-wicket-utils` still uses `javax.validation` internally

The issue is that `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` has a static initializer that fails because it can't find `javax.validation.Validation` class (since we now have `jakarta.validation` on the classpath instead).

The fundamental problem is that `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` is incompatible with `jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2`. The library was built against `javax.validation` and cannot work with `jakarta.validation`.

Looking at the options:
1. The project cannot use `jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2` with `pm-wicket-utils:5.0`
2. We need to either:
   - Revert to `javax.validation-api` 
   - Update `pm-wicket-utils` to support `jakarta.validation` (but no such version exists)

Let me check if there's a newer version of `pm-wicket-utils` that might support jakarta:

steps.message:
I see! There's `jakarta.validation-api:2.0.2` which is the Jakarta EE version of validation-api 2.x. But the key issue is that `hibernate-validator:6.2.0.Final` uses `javax.validation`, not `jakarta.validation`.

Looking at this more carefully, the problem is:
- `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` declares `jakarta.validation-api:2.0.2` as provided
- But `hibernate-validator:6.2.0.Final` (used by pm-wicket-utils) uses `javax.validation` internally
- So `pm-wicket-utils` source code uses `jakarta.validation` imports but at runtime it needs `hibernate-validator` which is built against `javax.validation`

Wait, that doesn't make sense. Let me look at the actual class files in `pm-wicket-utils`:

This confirms the issue: `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` is compiled against `javax.validation`, not `jakarta.validation`. The pom says `jakarta.validation-api` but the actual class uses `javax.validation`.

This is a bug in the `pm-wicket-utils:5.0` library - it declares `jakarta.validation-api` as a dependency but was compiled against `javax.validation`.

Given this situation, the correct fix for `wicket-crudifier` is:
1. Use `javax.validation:javax.validation-api` instead of `jakarta.validation:jakarta.validation-api`
2. Keep `hibernate-validator:6.2.0.Final` which is compatible with `javax.validation`

steps.message:
All 17 tests pass. Let me provide a summary of the fix:

## Summary

The compilation failure was caused by the upgrade from `jakarta.validation-api:2.0.2` to `jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2`. The key issue is that:

1. **The project depends on `pm-wicket-utils:5.0`**, which internally uses `javax.validation` (not `jakarta.validation`)
2. **`jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2` uses the `jakarta.validation.*` namespace**, which is incompatible with `javax.validation.*`
3. **The code in `ListControlGroups.java` used `javax.validation` imports**, which don't exist in `jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2`

### Changes Made

**pom.xml**: Changed the validation API dependency from:
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>jakarta.validation</groupId>
    <artifactId>jakarta.validation-api</artifactId>
    <version>3.0.2</version>
</dependency>
```
to:
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>javax.validation</groupId>
    <artifactId>validation-api</artifactId>
    <version>2.0.1.Final</version>
</dependency>
```

**Source files**: Since the original code already used `javax.validation` imports, no source code changes were actually needed. The imports in `ListControlGroups.java` and `BootstrapCrudifierFormTest.java` were reverted to `javax.validation`.

The `mvn compile` now succeeds and all 17 tests pass.
